# DeFi Trends This Quarter

A personal blog post about decentralized finance market trends.

Liquidity is rotating again. Yield farmers are chasing points programs,
restaking narratives are cooling off, and the big lending markets keep
absorbing volume from smaller competitors. Here are my notes on what
moved this quarter and what I am watching next: total value locked per
chain, the rise of intent-based bridging, and why everyone suddenly
cares about real-world assets again.

None of this is financial advice — it is a market diary.
